value: After the first chain and a separate raid gate, Seer Olum appears in Serpentshrine Cavern. He tells the seeker that Vashj’s followers uncovered the Deathsworn’s secret and tortured him for it. This is an access-dependent encounter in the Burning Crusade quest order, not proof that the raid gate caused Akama’s conspiracy. Olum has kept silent; now the plan is endangered, and Akama must choose what one friend can bear.
editorNote: Original paraphrase for research status. All source text is reproduced through secondary quest locators or later official retrospectives; compare with the original TBC client before lore approval.
